additional_info.subject: ID0451433-DC/Si-D/BE-[MP / R6 170002127] Plug 2 is in error CRM:02678000428
additional_info.body:
Hello Chlöe, good morning. I hope you are doing well today.
I checked this charger and found that the CCS HPC microcontroller is reporting an error.
Please measure on site, if in the XD16:15B you have 24V. If yes, then please continue measuring in XD16:15A and in the I3 of KF10. The 24V must reach the KF10.
If you don't have 24V from the XD16.15B, then the microcontroller is faulty and the CCS cable needs to be replaced.
Do you have someone that can take care of this troubleshooting? Do you have a spare CCS HPC cable?
I will wait for your feedback.
Best regards,
Francisco

additional_info.subject: ID0451433-DC/Si-D/BE-[MP / R6 170002127] Plug 2 is in error CRM:02678000428
additional_info.body:
Hi Wim, good afternoon!
thanks for the feedback, we all have bad days, it's completely ok.
I took a look at the diagram again and I can imagine that this can have a simple solution. Can you please check this connection on-site:
This XD10.3B/A is a connector that gets loose often and it might be that this is the answer because this connector is the one responsible for all the errors that I see on the error-flags.
This is located here:
How will you check this:
Fully turn off the charger
Open the converter plate from the front
Remove the XD10.3B from the A and plug it back again.
Example of a failure in XD10.3 from another charger:
It might not be as bad as this, but please plug it out and back in, you need to do it from the inside of the converters location and from the front of the charger.
Unfortunately, I'm not available tomorrow morning because I have some other site support for a different region and it's national holiday in Germany, so I couldn't find any available colleague.
Please keep me informed via email here and I will reply to it as soon as possible.
Thank you for your cooperation and support!
have a nice rest of the day and fingers crossed for tomorrow :D
Best regards,
Francisco

additional_info.subject: ID0451433-DC/Si-D/BE-[MP / R6 170002127] Plug 2 is in error CRM:02678000428
additional_info.body:
Hello Chlöe, good afternoon.
After today's site visit, we were able to identify the errors but the spare sparts needed were very different from the expected.
The KF11 is not working , we tested by using the neighbor charger's KF11 and the errors are gone.
But there is also another problem in between, the communication from the cooling unit seems to be faulted as well. When we disconnect these cables from the unit, the charger is fully operational and can charge, but when we connect the cables, the communication gets cut from the whole system.
The colleague provided feedback that the cooling unit was warm even though it was not working for 1 week at least. This must be verified on the next site visit when we replace the KF11. Is it possible to have a backup cooling unit for the visit? Since this is out of warranty, feel free to tell me what is best for you.
We have no guarantee that the pump is performing well and we can only give feedback after this next visit.
If you have any infra-red temperature sensor, it would be the best to confirm if indeed the pump was hot or not.
We put back the KF11 in the working charger and it's working well.
Let me know when you plan to go there again and schedule another meeting.
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco
